purpose: non-compositional material reference generation for the Industrial L2 pre-pixel quality reset

swatches.prompt: Create one seamless, tileable, square PBR-style material swatch of weathered galvanized corrugated steel cladding for a credible medium industrial logistics/manufacturing facility. Orthographic front-on material sample only, evenly and diffusely illuminated, neutral color balance, physically plausible fine zinc spangle, restrained oxidation at fasteners and lower ridges, vertical corrugation pitch large enough to read at game-sprite scale, no dramatic highlights. Edge-to-edge repeat with no seams. Non-compositional texture only: no building, facade, entrance, door, window, camera view, cast shadow, road, parcel, text, labels, people, vehicles, or objects. 1024x1024.
